name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Implicit Codex orchestration with adaptive IQ-gated worker routing, schema-checked inputs, generation fencing, contract-closed evidence, and exact-state acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive cost-aware workers with exact-state acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator implicitly classifies implementation work, verifies atomic low-risk edits directly in Sol, and routes schema-checked closed contracts through user-selectable or adaptive model/effort policies. Adaptive routes intersect Codex capabilities with validated IQ, sample, cost, and time evidence, pin one decision per graph, preflight native dispatch, fence stale results, preserve the original baseline, and gate exact-state completion through primary Sol evidence or a structurally required independent review epoch.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature using the default cost-aware route.
Classify this change, then use the least costly adequate execution lane.
Review this accumulated change set with a fresh review epoch.
